landscape.say: Local business spotlight: Atlanta Window Film Pros. They install window film for homes and businesses across Atlanta, cutting heat, glare and UV on the glass you already have.

landscape.label: Why Window Film Here
landscape.title: Why Atlanta Buildings Need Window Film
landscape.say: Atlanta sits on the Piedmont plateau at roughly a thousand feet, which takes a little of the edge off compared with coastal Georgia, but the summers are still long, hot and sticky. The air conditioning season usually runs from late spring well into October. Humid nights keep buildings from cooling off, so the heat a west wall of glass collects at 5 p.m. is still in the room the next morning.

landscape.say: For homes: Decorative: Reeded, etched-look and geometric patterns that dress up a front door sidelight, a transom over the porch or a glassed-in shower. Security: Thick clear safety film that keeps broken glass bonded and slows someone trying to get through a back door, sidelight or ground-floor window. Glare Reduction: Takes the washout off TV and laptop screens in home offices and media rooms, while the room still feels bright and the yard is still visible through the glass. Energy-Saving: Cuts the solar heat entering through problem windows, which trims the cooling load your Georgia Power bill reflects through a long summer, and keeps rooms more even.

landscape.say: For businesses: Solar Control: Commercial-grade film for curtain walls, ribbon windows and old warehouse sash, picked to suit what is already in the frame once they confirm the glass can safely take it. Conference Room Privacy: Meeting rooms with glass fronts get a band of obscuring film that hides screens and whiteboards from people walking the hall, yet the room keeps its light. Low-E: A coated film that trims summer solar gain and, on cold nights, reflects radiant room heat back indoors. Office: Film for the sunny sides of Atlanta office floors, from Midtown towers to Perimeter office parks.

landscape.label: Local Know-How
landscape.title: Commercial Window Tinting From Downtown to the Perimeter
landscape.say: Most of their work is commercial. Office towers in Downtown, Midtown and Buckhead stack floor after floor of glass along Peachtree Street and Peachtree Road, and the Perimeter Center market around I-285 and GA-400 in Sandy Springs and Dunwoody adds mid-rise towers and suburban office parks. Further out, the GA-400 corridor in Alpharetta and the office and flex buildings in Peachtree Corners and Johns Creek bring long ribbon windows and big parking lots that bounce heat back at the glass.

landscape.label: How It Works
landscape.title: How an install works

tiles.s: List the windows on the quote form with their rough sizes
Water trapped under the film evaporates over the following

landscape.say: Here's how an install works. First, list the windows on the quote form with their rough sizes and which way they face, plus the frame type if you know it. Then, on site they identify single-pane, dual-pane or low-E glass, note any fogged or failed seals, and stick sample swatches on the actual panes. On install day, floors and sills are covered, each pane is cleaned, and film is cut and squeegeed flat against the glass. Finally, water trapped under the film evaporates over the following days or weeks.
